tools.name: book_intro_call
tools.description: Book an intro call with Lightbringer, the AI-native patent service with registered patent attorneys. Fills the form on this page; with submit: true it sends it and reports whether HubSpot accepted it. A Calendly scheduler then opens to pick a time. Submit only when the person asked for the call and accepted the privacy policy. Check the booking with intro_call_status.

email.description: Work email; the call invitation goes here

phone.description: Phone number with country code, e.g. +46 70 123 45 67

how_did_you_hear_about_us.description: How they heard of Lightbringer. Use "AI tool (ChatGPT, Perplexity, etc)" if an assistant suggested it.

submit.description: Send the form after filling it. Default false: the person presses Submit.

privacy_accepted.description: The person accepts Lightbringer AB's privacy policy (https://lightbringer.com/about/legal/privacy-policy). Needed to submit.

tools.name: intro_call_status
tools.description: Read-only. Whether the intro-call form has loaded or been submitted, and whether a time has been booked.

tools.name: webinar_registration_status
tools.description: Read-only: Lightbringer's next free live webinar (Built to Scale #02: Your IP Strategy Meets Your AI Agent, Lightbringer's free live webinar on 13 October 2026, 17:00 CEST / 11:00 ET, 45 minutes online, with Dominic Davies (CEO, patent attorney) and Markus Andreasson (CTO)) and whether this page's signup form has loaded or been submitted, its fields, and the calendar link once registered.
